lessons_used: Sign-in hints (sign_in, hint) and waiting screen info updates (home, wait_info) consistently showed no clear effect across multiple tests.
Adoption redesigns (adoption, redesign) and path selection redesigns (choose_path, redesign) proved helpful, each producing one winning test alongside tests with no clear effect.
Adding new finish screens (finish, new_screen) did not help, resulting in one worse outcome and one with no clear effect.
Evidence remains thin for categories tested only once, such as sign-in reordering, adoption flows, home redesigns, and finish notifications.
Predictions were generally overly optimistic, though they underestimated the impact of winning tests like path selection redesign and initial path copy reframing.

lessons_next: Adoption redesigns (adoption, redesign), path selection redesigns (choose_path, redesign), and path copy reframing (choose_path, copy) proved helpful, each producing one winning test alongside tests with no clear effect.
Sign-in hints (sign_in, hint) and waiting screen info updates (home, wait_info) consistently showed no clear effect across multiple tests.
New finish screens (finish, new_screen), sign-in reordering (sign_in, reorder), and sign-in layout changes (sign_in, layout) did not help, resulting in worse outcomes or no clear effect.
Evidence remains thin for categories tested only once, such as adoption new flows, adoption incentives, home redesigns, and finish notifications.
Predictions were generally overly optimistic, though they underestimated the true impact of winning path selection redesigns and copy changes.
